verses.original: Τολμᾷ τις ὑμῶν πρᾶγμα ἔχων πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον κρίνεσθαι ἐπὶ τῶν ἀδίκων καὶ οὐχὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: Tolma tis hymōn pragma echōn pros ton heteron krinesthai epi tōn adikōn kai ouchi epi tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: If any of you has a grievance against another how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of . . . before the saints

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἅγιοι τὸν κόσμον κρινοῦσιν καὶ εἰ ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος ἀνάξιοί ἐστε κριτηρίων ἐλαχίστων
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti hoi hagioi ton kosmon krinousin kai ei en hymin krinetai ho kosmos anaxioi este kritēriōn elachistōn
verses.literal: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world And if you are to judge the world are you not competent to judge trivial cases

verses.original: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἀγγέλους κρινοῦμεν μήτιγε βιωτικά
verses.transliteration: ouk oidate hoti angelous krinoumen mētige biōtika
verses.literal: Do you not know that we will judge angels How much more the things of this life

verses.original: Βιωτικὰ μὲν οὖν κριτήρια ἐὰν ἔχητε τοὺς ἐξουθενημένους ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τούτους καθίζετε
verses.transliteration: Biōtika men oun kritēria ean echēte tous exouthenēmenous en tē ekklēsia toutous kathizete
verses.literal: So if you need to settle everyday matters do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church

verses.original: πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ὑμῖν λέγω οὕτως οὐκ ἔνι ἐν ὑμῖν οὐδεὶς σοφὸς ὃς δυνήσεται διακρῖναι ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros entropēn hymin legō houtōs ouk eni en hymin oudeis sophos hos dynēsetai diakrinai ana meson tou adelphou autou
verses.literal: I say this to your shame Is there really no one among you wise enough . . . . . . to arbitrate between his brothers

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀδελφὸς μετὰ ἀδελφοῦ κρίνεται καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ ἀπίστων
verses.transliteration: alla adelphos meta adelphou krinetai kai touto epi apistōn
verses.literal: Instead one brother goes to law against another and this in front of unbelievers

verses.original: ἤδη μὲν οὖν ὅλως ἥττημα ὑμῖν ἐστιν ὅτι κρίματα ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀδικεῖσθε διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀποστερεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: Ēdē men oun holōs hēttēma hymin estin hoti krimata echete meth’ heautōn dia ti ouchi mallon adikeisthe dia ti ouchi mallon apostereisthe
verses.literal: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already Why . . . not rather be wronged Why . . . not rather be cheated

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς ἀδικεῖτε καὶ ἀποστερεῖτε καὶ τοῦτο ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: alla hymeis adikeite kai apostereite kai touto adelphous
verses.literal: Instead you yourselves cheat and do wrong even against your own brothers

verses.original: Ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἄδικοι Θεοῦ βασιλείαν οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν μὴ πλανᾶσθε οὔτε πόρνοι οὔτε εἰδωλολάτραι οὔτε μοιχοὶ οὔτε μαλακοὶ οὔτε ἀρσενοκοῖται
verses.transliteration: Ē ouk oidate hoti adikoi Theou basileian ou klēronomēsousin mē planasthe oute pornoi oute eidōlolatrai oute moichoi oute malakoi oute arsenokoitai
verses.literal: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God Do not be deceived Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts

verses.original: οὔτε κλέπται οὔτε πλεονέκται οὐ μέθυσοι οὐ λοίδοροι οὐχ ἅρπαγες βασιλείαν Θεοῦ κληρονομήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: oute kleptai oute pleonektai ou methysoi ou loidoroi ouch harpages basileian Theou klēronomēsousin
verses.literal: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor verbal abusers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτά τινες ἦτε ἀλλὰ ἀπελούσασθε ἀλλὰ ἡγιάσθητε ἀλλὰ ἐδικαιώθητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai tauta tines ēte alla apelousasthe alla hēgiasthēte alla edikaiōthēte en tō onomati tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai en tō Pneumati tou Theou hēmōn
verses.literal: And that is what some of you were But you were washed you were sanctified you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God

verses.original: Πάντα μοι ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει Πάντα μοι ἔξεστιν ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐγὼ ἐξουσιασθήσομαι ὑπό τινος
verses.transliteration: Panta moi exestin all’ ou panta sympherei Panta moi exestin all’ ouk egō exousiasthēsomai hypo tinos
verses.literal: Everything is permissible for me but not everything is beneficial Everything is permissible for me but I will not be mastered by anything

verses.original: Τὰ βρώματα τῇ κοιλίᾳ καὶ ἡ κοιλία τοῖς βρώμασιν ὁ δὲ Θεὸς καὶ ταύτην καὶ ταῦτα καταργήσει τὸ δὲ σῶμα οὐ τῇ πορνείᾳ ἀλλὰ τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ ὁ Κύριος τῷ σώματι
verses.transliteration: Ta brōmata tē koilia kai hē koilia tois brōmasin ho de Theos kai tautēn kai tauta katargēsei to de sōma ou tē porneia alla tō Kyriō kai ho Kyrios tō sōmati
verses.literal: Food for the stomach and the stomach for food but God will destroy them . . . . . . both The body is not intended for sexual immorality but for the Lord and the Lord for the body

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς καὶ τὸν Κύριον ἤγειρεν καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐξεγερεῖ διὰ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho de Theos kai ton Kyrion ēgeiren kai hēmas exegerei dia tēs dynameōs autou
verses.literal: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead and He will raise us also . . .

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι τὰ σώματα ὑμῶν μέλη Χριστοῦ ἐστιν ἄρας οὖν τὰ μέλη τοῦ Χριστοῦ ποιήσω πόρνης μέλη μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate hoti ta sōmata hymōn melē Christou estin aras oun ta melē tou Christou poiēsō pornēs melē mē genoito
verses.literal: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them . . . with a prostitute Never

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὁ κολλώμενος τῇ πόρνῃ ἓν σῶμά ἐστιν Ἔσονται γάρ φησίν Οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti ho kollōmenos tē pornē hen sōma estin Esontai gar phēsin Hoi dyo eis sarka mian
verses.literal: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body For it is said The two will become . . . one flesh

verses.original: ὁ δὲ κολλώμενος τῷ Κυρίῳ ἓν πνεῦμά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ho de kollōmenos tō Kyriō hen pneuma estin
verses.literal: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit

verses.original: Φεύγετε τὴν πορνείαν πᾶν ἁμάρτημα ὃ ἐὰν ποιήσῃ ἄνθρωπος ἐκτὸς τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν ὁ δὲ πορνεύων εἰς τὸ ἴδιον σῶμα ἁμαρτάνει
verses.transliteration: Pheugete tēn porneian pan hamartēma ho ean poiēsē anthrōpos ektos tou sōmatos estin ho de porneuōn eis to idion sōma hamartanei
verses.literal: Flee from sexual immorality Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body but he who sins sexually sins against his own body

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι τὸ σῶμα ὑμῶν ναὸς τοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν Ἁγίου Πνεύματός ἐστιν οὗ ἔχετε ἀπὸ Θεοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐστὲ ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: ē ouk oidate hoti to sōma hymōn naos tou en hymin Hagiou Pneumatos estin hou echete apo Theou kai ouk este heautōn
verses.literal: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you whom you have received from God You are not your own

verses.original: ἠγοράσθητε γὰρ τιμῆς δοξάσατε δὴ τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τῷ σώματι ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ēgorasthēte gar timēs doxasate dē ton Theon en tō sōmati hymōn
verses.literal: you were bought at a price Therefore glorify God with your body
